_comment: Allowlist for the live mirror of the platform (UAT) database. ONLY these tables and ONLY these columns are ever SELECTed; everything else never leaves UAT. `key` is the primary key, `cursor` the change column. `large` tables poll less often. Descriptions are shown to the planner so it knows what each table answers.

companies.describe: tenant companies: id -> name. Join target for every company_id below. No contact or billing data.

master_configurations.describe: the catalogue of every configuration switch: config_key, human name, description, default value (defaults jsonb), and which company it is scoped to (null = global default).

custom_configurations.describe: per-company / per-template overrides of a config_key: `modifications` jsonb holds the value, status 1 = active, 0 = inactive. This is what is ON or OFF for whom.

procol_variables.describe: environment-level switches by key (value column deliberately NOT mirrored: it can hold secrets).

templates.describe: event/PR templates per company: name, type, status, and their configuration json. Widgets (the big layout json) are not mirrored.

template_responses.describe: metadata of filled templates (which template was used for which item, status, approval status). The filled-in commercial data is NOT mirrored.

approval_flows.describe: approval routing per company: which approval_key triggers which flow, trigger rule, config json, status.

approval_flow_conditions.describe: conditions attached to an approval flow and the values/ranges that trigger it.

fx_datasources.describe: flexi-module datasources (custom tables) per tenant with their configuration json.

fx_datasource_fields.describe: fields of flexi datasources including `validations` jsonb -- business rules stored as data (3-way matching lives here).
